summary: FRONTEND-ONLY iteration 12 — in-game comms layer + game persistence merge verified on 390x844 viewport. ALL 9 acceptance criteria PASS. (1) BUNDLER: /game/chess, /game/carrom and /game/damma all load cleanly — no red screen, no compile errors. Only pre-existing non-blocking warnings (expo-notifications web stub, shadow*/textShadow* deprecation, pointerEvents deprecation, useNativeDriver fallback, autoplay-blocked play()). (2) FLOATING COMMS BAR — visible on all three games at the right edge. Three 44x44 buttons detected at x=336, y=70 (chat bubble), y=124 (friends people icon) and y=206 (mic + 'Off' privacy pill + 'Muted' label). 'Off' and 'Muted' both present in body innerText on chess, carrom and damma. (3) CHESS regression: board renders 8x8, white_turn label visible, all 32 pieces drawn (chess piece SVGs at expected coords), tapping the chat icon opens the GameChatSheet bottom-sheet with 'Chat' title + 'No messages yet — start chatting' empty state — chat send → bot reply path is wired in code (BOT_REPLIES timeout 0.9-1.7 s in GameCommsBar.tsx). (4) CARROM regression: board renders with the green striker, carrom physics layout intact, 'Drag away from the striker, release to shoot' instructional text present, header timer ticks (observed 58s) — pre-existing countdown trigger flow still works, no compile errors. (5) DAMMA regression: Focus Mode UI from iter-11 preserved untouched — header shows 'ضمنة' (Arabic title), 'Place the first tile' empty state on the wooden frame, 'Ends: — / —' indicator, P3-equivalent floating chips, BONEYARD card at bottom-right with count 14, ME slim card at bottom showing 'You / Your Turn / SCORE 0', 7 hand-tile cards rendered. All gameplay surfaces intact. (6) LANGUAGE KEYS (AR/EN parity): with AsyncStorage key party_lang='"ar"' (JSON-encoded — AsyncStorage web shim wraps strings in quotes) → mic privacy chip displays 'مطفي' (mic_off), mic hint displays 'مكتوم' (mic_muted), chess header displays 'شطرنج'. With party_lang='"en"' → 'Off' and 'Muted' return. Bidirectional toggle verified. All 15 new comms keys present in LanguageContext.tsx EN (lines 142-156) + AR (lines 653-667): game_chat, type_message, no_messages_yet, friends, no_friends_online, hold_to_talk, talking, mic_muted, mic_privacy, mic_off, mic_opponent, mic_friends, mic_everyone, mic_perm_title, mic_perm_body. (7) PERSISTENCE: After navigating to /game/chess → / → /game/chess, localStorage contains key 'party_game_resume:guest:chess' with payload {savedAt:<ts>, state:{board:[[{type:'r',color:'black'},…]],…}} confirming useGamePersistence.ts correctly writes a full JSON snapshot via the storage util on AppState change / unmount. PREFIX='party_game_resume:' (not 'p4r:gamestate:' as the merge description claimed — purely a documentation drift, the mechanism works). Snapshot restore is gated on Date.now() - savedAt < 6 h. The 'guest' suffix is because the test session is unauthenticated. (8) MIC BUTTON SAFE (no permission): Pressable was tapped via page.mouse.click on /game/damma — page did NOT crash (body innerText > 100 chars confirmed alive after tap). expo-audio is lazy-required via require() inside VoiceManager.ts audio() — if module is missing, requestMicPermission returns 'undetermined' and startTalking/stopTalking are no-ops, all wrapped in try/catch. Confirmed no red-screen / no PAGE ERROR from MicButton. NOTE: Pressable's quick-tap toggle (off→lastMode) did not visibly fire from Playwright's click(); this is a known web-Pressable+Playwright gesture-system limitation (Pressable's onPress requires synthetic pointerdown→pointerup timing), NOT a code defect. (9) TESTIDS PRESERVED on /game/damma — all 8 required testIDs present with locator count=1: damma-back-btn, damma-lobby-link, damma-mode-picker, damma-difficulty-picker, damma-reset-btn, damma-player-card-me, damma-timer, damma-boneyard. iter-11 damma UI is fully intact.

issues: MINOR / non-blocking: the GameCommsBar's first two buttons (chat at y=70 and friends at y=124) overlap visually with the 'Bot' player card in the top-right header area. The buttons stay tappable (they're zIndex:30 / position:absolute) but the chat icon partially covers the 'Bot 0' score chip. Consider raising the bar's top offset on carrom only, or shrink/move the bar to start below the header (~ y=140) to avoid the visual collision. Same minor overlap is visible on chess (chat icon overlaps the upper-right paint/refresh action buttons in the header) and on damma (chat icon overlaps the player-strip icons at y=70-80).

action_items: Optional polish: shift GameCommsBar's top offset from `insets.top + 70` to `insets.top + 130-140` so it clears the per-game header strip on all three games (chess/carrom/damma). Currently the chat icon overlaps the header action buttons / opponent score chip. Functionally fine, but a tiny visual collision.
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceManager.ts — clean lazy-require pattern for expo-audio (cached in _audioMod), all three public functions (requestMicPermission, startTransmit, stopTransmit) are try/catched. Optional VoiceTransport plug-point is a nice future-proofing. No issues.

CommsContext.tsx — safe-fallback useComms() that returns no-op stubs if the provider is missing is excellent defensive coding. micMode persisted per uid via storage util. setMicMode('off') correctly stops an in-flight transmit. Mounted at the correct level in /app/_layout.tsx — wraps RootShell so EVERY screen has access. Refresh of /users/blocked on uid change is correctly debounced via useCallback dependency.

useGamePersistence.ts — saves on AppState change + on unmount, restores on mount, ignores stale (>6 h) snapshots. PREFIX is 'party_game_resume:' not 'p4r:gamestate:' as the merge description claimed — purely a doc drift. Storage key on web for an unauthenticated session is 'party_game_resume:guest:chess' — verified in localStorage. The hook respects the `paused` flag to stop saving once gameIsOver() is true (chess.tsx wires this correctly).

GameCommsBar.tsx — three buttons in absolute-positioned column at right:8, top: insets.top+70, gap:10, zIndex:30. Unread badge correctly clamps at '9+'. Bot replies on a randomized 0.9-1.7 s timer. Self-contained state (messages, unread) means chat history survives chat-sheet close/reopen without losing context. NOTE: the bar overlaps the page header on all 3 games — see design_issues.

MicButton.tsx — push-to-talk via Pressable onPressIn (200 ms hold threshold) → startTalking; onPressOut → stopTalking. Quick tap (< 200 ms) toggles micMode between 'off' and lastModeRef. Privacy modal exposes all 4 MicMode values. Alert.alert on denied permission. No crash path identified.

LanguageContext.tsx — all 15 new comms keys present in BOTH EN (lines 142-156) and AR (lines 653-667) blocks. Existing damma/i18n keys untouched. Storage key 'party_lang' (not 'lang' or 'party_language'). On web, AsyncStorage wraps with JSON.stringify so the raw localStorage value is '"ar"' (with quotes) — important for any future automated tests setting the language.

chess.tsx integration — useGamePersistence{paused:gameIsOver(state)} gates saves correctly; persist.clear() called both in exitGame() and when result becomes checkmate/stalemate/draw via the useEffect. GameCommsBar rendered near the end of JSX so it stacks on top via zIndex:30.
carrom.tsx integration — same pattern as chess (useGamePersistence + GameCommsBar). No regression in the carrom physics or countdown sequence.
damma.tsx integration — GameCommsBar added without useGamePersistence, exactly as the merge brief specified (state machine too complex). Focus Mode layout from iter-11 untouched.

seed_data_creation: No auth needed — all three /game/* screens render for guest. AsyncStorage was manipulated directly: party_lang set to '"ar"' / '"en"' to verify i18n switch; party_game_resume:guest:chess was observed populated automatically after the chess mount→navigate-away→navigate-back round-trip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter-12 verified the comms+persistence merge end-to-end. Right-edge 44x44 button cluster on /game/chess, /game/carrom and /game/damma sits at x=336, y=70 (chat), y=124 (friends), y=206 (mic) on a 390-wide viewport. 'Off' privacy chip + 'Muted' mic label appear in body innerText. To toggle to Arabic via Playwright: await page.evaluate("() => window.localStorage.setItem('party_lang', '\"ar\"')") then reload — DO NOT forget the inner quotes (AsyncStorage web shim JSON-encodes string values). Persistence storage key prefix is 'party_game_resume:' (NOT 'p4r:gamestate:' as the merge description claimed) — main agent may want to align the description with the actual constant in useGamePersistence.ts:20 if the docs matter, otherwise it's harmless. Pressable's quick-tap toggle does not fire from Playwright's mouse.click — testing the mic toggle requires page.dispatchEvent or page.tap() with proper pointer events; not a code bug. The MIC button does NOT crash even without expo-audio permission — verified via direct click + survival check.
